query:
WITH old AS (
             SELECT id, (COALESCE($2, subject) IS DISTINCT FROM subject
                         OR (CASE WHEN $3 THEN $4 ELSE preview_text END) IS DISTINCT FROM preview_text
                         OR COALESCE($5, blocks) IS DISTINCT FROM blocks
                         OR COALESCE($6, include_tags) IS DISTINCT FROM include_tags
                         OR COALESCE($7, exclude_tags) IS DISTINCT FROM exclude_tags) AS changed
             FROM campaigns WHERE id = $1
           )
           UPDATE campaigns c SET
             subject = COALESCE($2, c.subject),
             preview_text = CASE WHEN $3 THEN $4 ELSE c.preview_text END,
             blocks = COALESCE($5, c.blocks),
             include_tags = COALESCE($6, c.include_tags),
             exclude_tags = COALESCE($7, c.exclude_tags),
             archive_hidden = COALESCE($8, c.archive_hidden),
             status = CASE WHEN old.changed AND c.status = 'scheduled' THEN 'draft'::campaign_status ELSE c.status END,
             send_at = CASE WHEN old.changed AND c.status = 'scheduled' THEN NULL ELSE c.send_at END,
             updated_at = now()
           FROM old WHERE c.id = old.id
